title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP programme will be implemented in Dedza District in the Central Region of Malawi. The programme will work with 5 Cooperatives, 20 producer groups and will support 35,000 households (210,000 beneficiaries). There will be a particular focus on targeting women headed households and young people. The primary focus is on increasing food production and improving food and nutrition security. Demonstration plots will be established, lead farmers will be trained in Climate Smart Agricultureand CSA techniques will be cascaded to farmers at community level. A functional landscape approach will be applied, which supports livelihoods activities while still protecting the environment and natural resources. The programme will support communities to engage in agroforestry/conservation agriculture with trees and integrate agroforestry into agricultural activities. Rearing of small livestock will also be supported. Communities will be supported to develop forestry management plans and irrigation systems will be scaled up. Participatory watershed and forestry management structures will be put in place and the capacity of Village Natural Resource Committees will be strengthened.Use of efficient cookstoves and of alternatives to charcoal, such as solar power and woodlots, will be promoted.The programme also aims to increase access to credit and agricultural inputs, to link farmers to markets and to suppliers of post-harvest technologies. At policy level, SHA Malawi will work with the Ministry of Agriculture, Irrigation and Water to ensure agricultural practices are more sustainable in the long-term and will lobby government for increased investment in CSA.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome1: Equitable and inclusive stewardship of natural resources to support livelihoods and healthy ecosystems. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: A project in Malawi which aims to increase food and income security for those most vulnerable to climate change in the Dedza District, supporting stakeholder and policy engagement on sustainable landscapes, livelihoods and climate action. Marked 2 for Adaptation.
